recap.text: Kandy Newton, a level 29 sluggalo with pink-dyed hair and a hatchet growing from her crown, bursts out of Carl's slugpox and kills the Sepsis Whore. She joins Carl, calling herself Bigs, and hacks through Victory's leg. After arriving on a swamp yak, she bounces to Donut's battle playlist and threatens to chop conscripted women. Bigs dislikes Li Na for a move involving Sneaky Tyler C and a potion.

Kandy Newton gets orange goo on a carpet borrowed from the Larracos College of Magic. Carl keeps slugpox under an Emberus ring until a level 30 slug named Lil' Mello Haze bursts from his back in blood and pus. Kandy and the sluggalos slaughter bankers and politicians before driving a chicken truck. Kandy tells Carl they lost Hedy, pointing with her head hatchet at a wrecked ice-cream truck.

beats.headline: Credit for the kill
beats.text: For the record: System Message. The Sepsis Whore of the Blood Sultanate has fallen. Credit for the kill has been given to Kandy "Bigs" Newton of the Princess Posse. Katia asks who the hell that is. The answer: a sluggalo who burst out of Crawler Carl's back, out of his slugpox, and planted a hatchet between Vinata's eyes. Level 29. The size of a bulldog, pink-dyed hair in a monk's ring, piercings down her head, a single hatchet growing from its crown, dripping. Oh, daddy, you don't look so good.
beats.gist: Kandy Bigs Newton is a level 29 sluggalo with pink-dyed hair and a dripping crown hatchet.

beats.headline: Call me Bigs
beats.text: Samantha flies in, a charred husk, and the subject objects: He's mine, bitch. When Victory returns, the subject swings at her too, and the hatchet goes straight through her leg. With an ogre and a squad of mantaurs closing in, Crawler Carl asks, Okay, Kandy is it? Stay with him and kill anyone in his way. Call me Bigs, the subject says, flecking naga blood everywhere. Is this ogre dude a friend, or is he getting kneecapped? Not a friend. After the fight: Who am I killing?

beats.headline: Imma get my chop on
beats.text: Dong Quixote arrives through a teleport trap on Gonk the swamp yak, which was not the plan, and the subject arrives on the back of it, which was even less the plan. New paint: a massive teardrop on the stalk of her right eye. She leaps off with a whoop, waving the axe. Imma get my chop on today. Where the bad guys at? She heard from another slug that Justice Light says a mount through a teleport trap brings every rider. Carl orders her back on the yak.
beats.gist: Dong Quixote arrives on Gonk the swamp yak through a teleport trap with Kandy Bigs Newton.

beats.headline: Outside the witness's reach
beats.text: A witness spell has pulled almost everyone into a frozen pile. Left out of it: Carl, Dong Quixote, the pets, Jamal and the subject. Only Carl and Dong carry the invulnerable glow; Jamal and the subject simply were not affected. Carl already knows why: the system counts the sluggalos and the former tattoos as a different kind of NPC. At the Madness castle she bounces to Donut's distant battle playlist while Carl tries to clear the halls.
beats.gist: A witness spell freezes most people, but Kandy Newton, Carl, and others remain unaffected.

beats.headline: One of you is getting the chop
beats.text: The subject ties up Selvi and Tuba, the two conscripted women from Burcu's party, and asks whether she can kill one of them, since that one is already bleeding pretty good. She is a friend, Carl says. Keep them safe. I'll wait until he's gone, the subject whispers loudly to them. Then one of you is getting the chop. Carl sends her off on reconnaissance instead. Yeah, baby. She returns: Yo, daddy-o, the front door is wide open. Nothing out there but fields.
beats.gist: Kandy Newton ties up Selvi and Tuba and asks to kill one.

beats.headline: No, she's a bad guy
beats.text: The subject growls, strangely dog-like, when she looks up at Li Na. She's not a bad guy, Carl says; her brother died. No, she's a bad guy, says the subject. You know what she did to Sneaky Tyler C? Tied a potion to him and ordered him to run right into the god. He blew up the moment he touched it. That is what she heard. It was a bitch-ass move. She does not like her.
beats.gist: Kandy Newton growls at Li Na and says she is a bad guy.

beats.headline: Girl talk on borrowed carpet
beats.text: Samantha's account. Samantha has promised to catch Tipid up on Faction Wars herself, and the subject slimes up: Yo, I want to hear this, too. Samantha likes her even though she gets orange goo all over the new carpet borrowed from the Larracos College of Magic. They have girl talk. The subject is now invited to Samantha's bachelorette party. Samantha tells it all, down to the thing at the bottom of the dungeon waking up. I thought you explained it perfect, says the subject.
beats.gist: Samantha and Kandy Newton have girl talk on carpet borrowed from the Larracos College of Magic.

beats.headline: You're going to drown in fire
beats.text: Mordecai's new form glitches whenever a different race comes near him for the first time, and when the subject wandered in, Rosetta feared they had lost him entirely. He told the subject she was going to drown in fire. If he were not on the don't-chop list, he would be getting the kneecap treatment. He also told Splash Zone he was going to die screaming while his family watched. Mordecai: nobody should put stock in it. This stuff is designed to be scary, not true.
beats.gist: Mordecai tells Kandy Newton she will drown in fire during a glitch.

beats.headline: How come I didn't get no hat
beats.text: An enchanted hat and an enchanted headband for the pets, each with a list of powers, and the subject wants to know why she did not get a hat. Because she is not a pet, Carl says. She is technically a mercenary. Mordecai suspects that if they reach the eleventh floor, Donut's class may come with mercenary accessories too.
beats.gist: Kandy Newton asks why she did not get an enchanted hat.

beats.headline: The sluggalo code, and Real Gs
beats.text: Dong Quixote is dying on the couch with the subject covering his head, glaring at Carl. She lays out the sluggalo code: unity, support, family, and kneecapping bitches. Carl provides none of it, is not killing the Li Na murderer, and is not letting her kneecap anyone. That makes him the bitch. You're right, Carl says. I'm sorry. Wait, I am? Carl remembers saying they need to help each other or stop being something. Real Gs? she offers. Real Gs. You're a good daddy, she says. But not the one he owes an apology.
beats.gist: Kandy Newton tells Carl the sluggalo code while Dong Quixote dies on the couch.

beats.headline: The birth that saved his ass
beats.text: Crawler Carl has kept his slugpox active under the Emberus ring on purpose, arguing that the birth of the subject on the previous floor saved his ass. Everyone else thought this was a terrible idea. The cure Mordecai made sits on the crafting table. Pop: a level 30 slug bursts out of his back in a shower of blood and pus, backward cap on an eye stalk. His name is Lil' Mello Haze, a level higher than the subject and much smaller.
beats.gist: Carl keeps slugpox active under the Emberus ring; Lil' Mello Haze bursts from his back.

beats.headline: Never been so proud
beats.text: The airship's bay doors open and the sluggalos rain down onto the stands, among the masked bankers and politicians who cannot fight back, and start to slaughter them one by one. The smallest of the small, the lowest form of dungeon NPC. From the subject, in the chat: I've never been so proud. Unity, support, family, and kneecapping bitches! Hell yeah!
beats.gist: Kandy Newton rains sluggalos from airship bay doors to slaughter masked bankers and politicians.

beats.headline: Get out of our chair
beats.text: Carl needs the worst possible drivers for the last part. Yeah, get out of our chair, the subject tells Tipid. We's driving. The blood-soaked sluggalos pile into the chicken truck, and someone turns on the deep fryer: the Sluggalo Chick-Chick Express is open for business. Carl orders the fryer off, since it is going to splash or catch fire and burn them all to death. The subject: You do your thing. We do our thing. Don't worry about us, Daddy. When the great door opens: You got it!
beats.gist: Carl hires Kandy Newton and blood-soaked sluggalos to drive the chicken truck with a deep fryer.

beats.headline: We lost Hedy
beats.text: The chicken truck, so smashed that Carl is surprised it runs, spins, slows and pulls up beside him. About ten sluggalos are left inside, and the whole thing stinks of fire. The subject leans out of the window. We done killing? For now, Carl says: thirty minutes to collapse, gather the survivors and get back to the safe room. Sure thing, daddy-o. Then, head lowered, she tells him: We lost Hedy. She points with her head hatchet at the wreck of the ice-cream truck.
beats.gist: A smashed chicken truck pulls up and Kandy Newton tells Carl they lost Hedy.
